description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 1834/48 of 01.11.2013, Homagama D/S Division and other amendments
reasoning: This gazette content deals exclusively with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act, specifically addressing corrections to land parcel descriptions, village names, Grama Niladhari divisions, and land extents.
